description: Review finding GAP-9: No privacy considerations section; CO-side observation and data-subject rights unaddressed (lens GAP). There is no hit for erasure, GDPR or data subject, and §12.4 covers only IO observation. `deviceLabel: "Alice's MacBook Pro"` and `platform` are written into the public DID document (02:359-360). Keep the per-CO-component observation tables, the minimization guidance and the erasure model (which records can be deleted, which cannot, and crypto-shredding).
